name: Special education disputes by state (IDEA Part B): complaints, mediation and due process, school years 2012-13 to 2023-24
description: The U.S. Department of Education's counts of special education disputes under IDEA Part B for the nation, every state, DC and five territories, by school year: written state complaints, mediation requests and mediations held, due process complaints, resolution meetings, hearings and complaints withdrawn or dismissed.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Special education disputes by state (IDEA Part B): complaints, mediation and due process, school years 2012-13 to 2023-24 (Version 1.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24011352

distribution.name: idea-disputes.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: idea-disputes.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

recordSet.name: idea-disputes
recordSet.description: The records of Special education disputes by state (IDEA Part B): complaints, mediation and due process, school years 2012-13 to 2023-24, one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id (never reused)

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter state or territory code, or US

field.name: level
field.description: us or state (every state, DC, Puerto Rico, American Samoa, Guam, the Northern Mariana Islands and the U.S. Virgin Islands)

field.name: area
field.description: US, or the 2-digit state FIPS code

field.name: areaName
field.description: Jurisdiction name

field.name: stateName
field.description: Jurisdiction name

field.name: status
field.description: P: the Department's own state-level data file

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: value
field.description: Due process complaints filed in the latest published school year (the same as dpc_latest)

field.name: unit
field.description: Unit of value

field.name: firstYear
field.description: First school year in the file for this jurisdiction (for example 2012-13)

field.name: latestYear
field.description: Latest school year published for this jurisdiction

field.name: wsc_latest
field.description: Written, signed state complaints (item 1)

field.name: wsc_reports_latest
field.description: Written complaints with a report issued (1.1)

field.name: med_requests_latest
field.description: Mediation requests (2)

field.name: med_held_latest
field.description: Mediations held (2.1)

field.name: dpc_latest
field.description: Due process complaints (3)

field.name: res_meetings_latest
field.description: Resolution meetings held on due process complaints (3.1)

field.name: hearings_latest
field.description: Due process hearings fully adjudicated (3.2)

field.name: dpc_withdrawn_latest
field.description: Due process complaints withdrawn or dismissed (3.4)

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: First day of the latest school year (July 1)

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: Last day of the latest school year (June 30)

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: Date the files were last re-read from the Department

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: Sources, separated by " | "

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
